tasks.title: Fix failed GitHub Actions after dependency upgrade

comments.body: Inspect failed runs for commit 325d94d with gh CLI, repair workflow/dependency regressions, validate, commit as Steve Grehan, and push.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Active project_id confirmed: zpcdjsc. Investigating runs 32253101018, 32253101017, and 32253101021.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Root causes confirmed: Bun's Linux runner exposed cross-file singleton storage interference in tests; canonical test command now uses --isolate. The configured Fly app was deleted and its DNS no longer exists, so stale Fly workflow/config were removed. Local suite, five randomized seeds, typecheck, and build pass.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Release follow-up: preset v10 is incompatible with semantic-release's current writer v8. Pinned latest compatible preset v9.3.1; local semantic-release dry-run now generates notes successfully. Added missing v0.1.1 baseline tag at 83dab2f (the commit changing CLI version 0.0.0 -> 0.1.1), so next release resolves to intended v0.2.0 instead of v1.0.0.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Release follow-up 2: @semantic-release/git attempted to push generated CHANGELOG/version files directly to protected main and was rejected by the repository PR rule. Removed self-committing changelog/git plugins; GitHub release notes remain enabled, branch protection stays intact, and no bot-authored release commits will be created. Dry-run succeeds.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Release follow-up 3: legacy cleanup deleted bun.lock immediately before bun publish, causing workspace dependency resolution failure. Removed cleanup; bun publish --dry-run now packs exactly package.json + dist/index.js successfully. Failed run left orphan v0.2.0 tag at f53f241 with no GitHub/npm release; removing it before retry.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Release follow-up 4: Bun packs workspace dependencies correctly but does not consume npm trusted-publishing OIDC credentials. Publish command now uses Bun to create a workspace-resolved tarball and npm CLI to publish it with OIDC/provenance. Exact hybrid command passes local npm dry-run; tarball contains only package.json and dist/index.js.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Release reached npm with a valid tarball and signed provenance, then failed because setup-node supplied npm 10, below npm trusted publishing's required 11.5.1. Updating the workflow to Node 24.15.0 and npm 12.0.2.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Fixed all failures following dependency upgrade. CI and Docker publish succeeded in GitHub Actions run 32254860947; release succeeded in run 32254860891; flux-tasks@0.2.0 and GitHub release v0.2.0 were verified live. Commits and direct pushes were authored as Steve Grehan.

tasks.title: Fix project deletion

comments.body: User reports that deleting a project does not work; trace UI, API, and storage paths.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Root cause: web deleteProject used bare fetch, omitting the auth token required by DELETE /api/projects/:id, and ignored non-2xx responses. Fixed it to use authFetch, return success, and keep UI state open on rejection. Added web API regression coverage. Verified 246 tests pass and full typecheck/build succeeds.
comments.author: user

comments.body: Delivered as commit c3a0c0f (fix(web): authenticate project deletion requests) and pushed directly to origin/main.
comments.author: user

acceptance_criteria: Deleting a project succeeds through the web UI and API
Project data is removed consistently and tests cover the regression
